newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi Elec aims at sharply higher TFT-LCD sales.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi Elec aims at sharply higher TFT-LCD sales.

text.p: Mitsubishi Electric Corp said on Thursday that it aims to expand its sales of thin film transistor liquid crystal displays (TFT-LCDs) to 100 billion yen in 2000 from 30 billion yen in fiscal 1996/97.
Mitsubishi Electric produces its TFT-LCDs at Advanced Display Inc, a joint venture with Asahi Glass Co Ltd in which Mitsubishi Electric holds an 80 percent stake.
Mitsubishi Electric concurrently announced that it and Advanced Display agreed with Chunghwa Picture Tube Ltd of Taiwan to provide TFT-LCD technology to the Taiwanese firm.
Chunghwa Picture Tube, an affiliate of Tatung Co Ltd, a major manufacturer of electric equipment, is expected to start production of the advanced-technology LCDs in January 1999.
Some of the LCDs produced at Chunghwa Picture Tube will be supplied to Mitsubishi Electric to be sold under Mitsubishi's brand name.
Mitsubishi Electric will also receive fees for the technology it provides to the Taiwanese firm, a Mitsubishi spokesman said.
Mitsubishi Electric said in a statement that the TFT-LCD market is expected to grow as much as 30 percent annually, reaching 1.5 trillion yen in 2000.
